title: Stabilization, validation state, and architecture preparation
scope: Complete safe Vehicle/Chassis stabilization, add structured persisted validation-result truth, define additive versioned service boundaries, and document the localStorage-to-PostgreSQL migration path without changing the current technician workflow.
objectives: Strengthen relational Vehicle/Chassis and installed-engine separation regressions.
Persist versioned validation results with explicit status and lifecycle state so stale or missing evidence cannot appear verified.
Define versioned domain/service contracts and a backward-compatible migration adapter for existing saved jobs.
Document the safe future migration from localStorage to PostgreSQL.
constraints: No broad frontend rewrite, backend deployment, or fake production service.
Existing saved jobs and technician workflow remain compatible.
Unknown, stale, superseded, invalidated, and unverified states remain explicit.
Chassis identity and installed-engine identity remain independent.
Preserve CT-0058 repository-scoped permissions and protected Git workflow.

acceptanceTests.expected: Historical and current relational Vehicle/Chassis selections retain exact downstream reset, missing-trim, and escape-path behavior.
acceptanceTests.evidence: Vehicle registry and browser cascade suites passed; 35,036 relational records spanning 1955-2027, exact 1983 checks, both selector surfaces, downstream resets, missing-trim and escape paths.

acceptanceTests.expected: Saved validation results capture the required provenance, relationship, evidence, timestamp, result, and lifecycle fields.
acceptanceTests.evidence: Contract and real-browser persistence assertions passed for schema/type/result/lifecycle/timestamp/source/subject/fingerprint/evidence.

acceptanceTests.expected: Missing, stale, superseded, invalidated, or unknown validation cannot be reported as current/verified.
acceptanceTests.evidence: Contract tests cover all lifecycle states; workflow test proves changed chassis makes an earlier pass stale and not verified; legacy outcomes import without current status.

acceptanceTests.expected: Legacy saved jobs load through the additive contract adapter without losing chassis or installed-engine identity.
acceptanceTests.evidence: v31 browser migration preserved vehicle, measurements, correction history, product boundary, and additive contract; engine-swap tests kept Ford installed-engine identity separate from 1983 Oldsmobile chassis.

acceptanceTests.expected: Canonical CarbTune validation and diff/static checks pass.
acceptanceTests.evidence: npm run validate passed all 6 programs and 158 workflow assertions; git diff --check passed.

implementationNotes: Assignment supplied directly by the product owner; no prior chat state assumed.
Structured contracts are additive adapters; PostgreSQL, services, authentication, tenancy, media storage, and conflict policy remain future authorized work.
Human field acceptance of the relational selector remains pending; automated stabilization is complete.

validation.summary: All 6 canonical programs passed, including 158 workflow/browser assertions; diff/static checks passed.
